english.title: Unlawfully export a horse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) shipped a horse, namely **(..DESCRIBE THE HORSE..), in

(A)_[a vessel,]_
(B)_[an aircraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE VESSEL OR AIRCRAFT..), from

(C)_[a port,]_
(D)_[an aerodrome,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORT OR AERODROME..), in Great Britain to

(E)_[a port,]_
(F)_[an aerodrome,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE PORT OR AERODROME OUTSIDE BRITISH ISLANDS..), outside of the British Islands without the horse having been examined by a veterinary inspector appointed by the Minister immediately before shipment and without it being certified in writing by the inspector to comply with the conditions of section 40(2) of the Animal Health Act 1981
english.legislation: Contrary to sections40 and 75(2)of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
ship a horse
in a vessel / aircraft
from a port / aerodrome in GB
to a port / aerodrome outside British Islands
without horse being examined by vet inspector appointed by Minister immediately before shipment and horse being certified in writing by inspector to comply with conditions of s40(2)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence should not be used after the 21st July 2024 due to changes made by the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Act 2024. For the offence applying after this date, see H101749.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecution
Complex see legislation.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
